_edit: Edit each release: version is the release number (csproj <Version>), 2 to 4 items. title says what it is, how says where to click to try it now. icon is one of sparkles, armchair, activity, link, book-open, rocket (Lucide).

items.title: Forsk opens ready
items.how: Type Forsk in Rhino and start. No mcpstart: the bridge is only for outside AI apps.

items.title: Release notes
items.how: Settings → Release notes shows this card again whenever you want.

items.title: Furniture in More actions
items.how: Open More actions and pick Add furniture or Furnish rooms.
